title: vue-html-bridge settings
description: Configuration shared by the vue-html-bridge language server and CLI (settings.md).

$schema.description: A JSON Schema reference for editor tooling; not itself a bridge setting.

version.description: Reserved for a future settings schema version.

enabled.description: Whether the bridge analyzes this workspace at all.

include.description: Glob patterns for `.vue` files to analyze.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from analysis.

validateOnChange.description: Editor-session only (ignored by one-shot hosts): revalidate as the document changes.

validateOnSave.description: Editor-session only (ignored by one-shot hosts): revalidate when the document is saved.

debounceMs.description: Editor-session only (ignored by one-shot hosts): debounce interval before revalidating.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent validations. Omit to delegate to the analyzer's CPU-count-based default.

warnVariantCount.description: Variant count above which core reports a warning. Omit to delegate to core's default of 256.

customElements.description: Tag names or globs treated as known custom elements.

name.description: The directive name without "v-" (e.g. "src", "imgAttr"); matched camelized.

attributes.description: Attribute name -> value template: a literal string constant, or "$value" optionally followed by dotted property segments (e.g. "$value.src").

customDirectives.description: Declares which attributes a custom directive sets and how to derive each value from the directive's bound expression.

externalAdapters.description: Whether adapters outside the bundled Markuplint adapter may be loaded.

adapter.description: The built-in adapter id (e.g. "markuplint") or an external adapter's npm package specifier.

settings.description: Adapter-specific settings, opaque to this schema.

validators.description: The configured validator adapters, in order.
